meeting.summary: Department-by-department FY2022 budget walk-through. Sheriff's Office requested two to three sworn officers; Special Events, PIO, Recorder's Office, Utility Billing, Finance, IT, Economic Development, Parks, Public Utilities, Streets, Library, and Fleet each presented personnel, equipment, and capital needs (Downtown Master Plan, Trails Master Plan, Outdoor Recreation Grant trailhead, vote-by-mail elections, lectern and digital signage upgrades, etc.).
